title_en: The Words He Did Not Know

production.direction_en: Battle UI dissolves to a still VN composition: Mahmut kneels beside Fadyme under the dim eclipse. The others wait beyond a broken arch, close enough to help but giving them privacy. The narration is quiet; no music for the first exchange.
production.music_direction_en: silence for the first lines; bgm_fadyme_theme enters on piano only when Mahmut first speaks her name; no percussion anywhere in this scene

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: All this time, you were carrying something alone.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: I thought if I smiled, the curse would have to wait its turn.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: I know. I wanted to be more than the person you were trying to save.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: You are. You are the person who made every road feel like it led somewhere.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: Then let me ask for one selfish thing. Stay until I fall asleep.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: I will stay when you wake, too.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: You still do not understand. I am dying, Mahmut. The curse is taking my hours one by one.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Then I will find the hand that wrote this curse. I will not let it write the last line.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: I was afraid you would look at me and see a final hour.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: I see you. I should have seen you sooner.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: You did not know. That is why I could keep pretending.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Then I have one more thing to confess. I knew Yseldra. I saw her call you to the altar that night, and I told you I did not know her.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: I know. I heard it in the cathedral. We were both pretending, Mahmut. Let us stop together.

commands.speaker: narrator
commands.text: For one breath, the eclipse above them thinned. Fadyme's fingers found Mahmut's, and the darkness beneath her skin did not retreat.
